    {
        if (obj is null)
        {
            throw new System.ArgumentNullException(nameof(obj));
        }
        var size = 0;
        size += sizeof(int); // Count size for Data
        size += (obj.Data?.Count ?? 0) * sizeof(byte);
        return size;
    }

        this.Data = data;

    public static MyPacket Deserialize(ref System.ReadOnlySpan<byte> buffer)
    {
        System.Collections.Generic.List<byte> data;
        var dataCount = global::FourSer.Gen.Helpers.RoSpanReaderHelpers.ReadInt32(ref buffer);
        var dataValue = new System.Collections.Generic.List<byte>(checked((int)dataCount));
        System.Runtime.InteropServices.CollectionsMarshal.SetCount(dataValue, checked((int)dataCount));
        global::FourSer.Gen.Helpers.RoSpanReaderHelpers.ReadBytes(ref buffer, System.Runtime.InteropServices.CollectionsMarshal.AsSpan(dataValue));
        data = dataValue;
        var obj = new MyPacket(data);
        return obj;
    }

    public static MyPacket Deserialize(System.ReadOnlySpan<byte> buffer)
    {
        return Deserialize(ref buffer);
    }

    public static void Serialize(MyPacket obj, ref System.Span<byte> data)
    {
        if (obj is null)
        {
            throw new System.ArgumentNullException(nameof(obj));
        }
        if (obj.Data is null)
        {
            global::FourSer.Gen.Helpers.SpanWriterHelpers.WriteInt32(ref data, (int)(0));
        }
        else
        {
            global::FourSer.Gen.Helpers.SpanWriterHelpers.WriteInt32(ref data, (int)(obj.Data.Count));
            global::FourSer.Gen.Helpers.SpanWriterHelpers.WriteBytes(ref data, System.Runtime.InteropServices.CollectionsMarshal.AsSpan(obj.Data));
        }
    }

    public static void Serialize(MyPacket obj, System.Span<byte> data)
